title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-5.6 after government greenlight — and announces ‘ChatGPT Work’
slides: Did OpenAI just reshape enterprise work with GPT-5.6?
It received government approval for broader deployment.
GPT-5.6 can negotiate contracts and generate code autonomously.
Your workflows now shift from prompting to supervising AI agents.
Test a single recurring task with ChatGPT Work this week.
thread_text:
1. Your job just changed

Government approval means GPT-5.6 now runs autonomously on enterprise data. You are no longer the prompter.

2. Negotiates like a lawyer

The model handles contract clauses and vendor terms without human input at each step.

3. Code without oversight

GPT-5.6 generates production-level code and pushes commits. Review replaces writing.

4. Supervise, don't prompt

Your daily workflow shifts from crafting prompts to monitoring agent outputs. Lower skill ceiling, higher stakes.

5. Test this week

Pick one recurring task in ChatGPT Work. Let it run. Does the output save time or create rework? Measure before you trust.
